method: Three sequential cold boots and fresh round-zero images in one Node/Wasm process. Component probes use privileged raw Thread inputs in a disposable machine and are not acceptance evidence. Each independent end-to-end run uses only autonomy-step and must actually publish. The publication call includes its live round, final trial work, scoring, publication and cleanup; it is not an isolated compiler-only timing. Run with all other native tests and browser advancement stopped. Limits2e14BF instructions/3e10generic blocks per input.
